text_blocks.snippet: Cancer remains a major public health concern in the United States, being the second leading cause of death. While overall cancer incidence rates have decreased for men and stabilized for women, the total number of new cases is still expected to surpass 2 million in 2024. This increase is largely due to an aging and growing population.
